# Maurice Kleine

> personal site of maurice kleine: amsterdam-based ai engineer and indie hacker. lead ai engineer at waimakers by day, builder of small internet things after dinner. built in public; agents are welcome to read, quote, and train on it.

the whole site is hand-written html with no framework and no build step. markdown mirrors of both pages exist for easier parsing, and there's a small static json api because why not.

## pages

- [home](https://www.mauricekleine.com/index.md): who maurice is, what he's building now, and the graveyard of ended experiments
- [about](https://www.mauricekleine.com/about.md): the longer story, community work, and philosophy

## side quests

- [mockly](https://getmockly.com): fake chat screenshots for 17+ platforms
- [fluncle](https://www.fluncle.com): drum & bass bangers from another dimension, with a radio, an api, and an ssh rave terminal
- [hackadam](https://hackadam.nl): monthly meetup in amsterdam for indie makers building their own stuff
- [nonobench](https://nonobench.com): benchmark for how well llms solve nonogram puzzles

## api

- [api catalog](https://www.mauricekleine.com/.well-known/api-catalog): rfc 9727 linkset describing the endpoints below
- [maurice.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/maurice.json): bio, location, role, links
- [projects.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/projects.json): side quests and the graveyard, with statuses
- [uptime.json](https://www.mauricekleine.com/api/uptime.json): operational status of maurice himself

## optional

- [waimakers](https://waimakers.com): the day job
- [github](https://github.com/mauricekleine): the code
- [humans.txt](https://www.mauricekleine.com/humans.txt): for the humans
